description: §19.16.2 — a `fail` exit runs the block's deferred bodies. save(0) registers `defer @cleaned = @cleaned + 1`, then fails with Rejected("non-positive"); the deferred body still runs (@cleaned = 1) and the caller's `!{}` handler recovers (@result = "failed: non-positive").
rationale: §19.16.2 Exit lists `fail` (§19.3) among the exit paths that run every registered deferred body exactly once. The failure itself is unchanged by the defer — it still reaches the caller's handler (§19.4.3).
